profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
Malcolm graduated from Howard University with a B.S in Computer Engineering
where he played football for 4 years on a full scholarship. He has been a
Software Engineer at Capital One for 2 years. In his two years at Capital One, he
has extensive experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS). He also has
experience with programming languages like Javascript, Typescript, Python,
HTML, CSS, and SQL to help master full-stack development. He completed two
Software Engineering internships in his 4 years at Howard University where he
also worked with a few of these different programming languages. He was a
mentor with a nonprofit named "Boys2Kings" where he did numerous activities
including the service of his community and pouring his knowledge back into the
youth. He is also a mentor at Capital One for the Capital One Development
Academy program to help recent college graduates have a smooth transition to
the company. Malcolm is a very fast learner and is eager to learn new
technologies.

positions.title: Optimization Engineering Intern
positions.description:
▪ Collect and aggregate building data sources (HVAC, energy, water, etc.) and assist Optimization Engineers with
analysis and development of operational and efficiency improvements
▪ Use Excel and Microsoft PowerBI to input & visualize data
▪ Input building utility data and analyze for energy efficiency opportunities

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developing effective, maintainable code in a timely fashion with SQL and DBeaver.
•	Ensuring code compiles with security policies and guidelines.
•	Creating visualizations of real time data with Microsoft Power BI, making it easier to read and understand.
•	Working on a team business case to present to the COO of Asurion.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Boys2Kings is a mentoring program intended to match young men with lifelong mentors to help guide them through their life journey. 
We believe that we are better together and it is important to use our experiences to help the next man.
We strive to be the change we wish to see by using our platform to bring awareness to the issues our young black men face and promote healthy communication, leadership, and life skills.
